# Neil Sethi

> Healthcare product lead and former engineer, based in the San Francisco Bay Area. Builds software for clinicians and patients. Currently Director of Platform Product and Partnerships at 1health (Tachin.AI).

Contact: neil@percipience.live
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/sethineil/
Résumé (PDF): https://neil.percipience.live/neil-sethi-resume.pdf
Résumé (Markdown): https://neil.percipience.live/resume.md

## Selected work

- [Xolv: ABA treatment planning and reporting](https://neil.percipience.live/case-studies/behavioral-health/): Director of Product Management, Oct 2022 – Apr 2024. Led four cross-functional pods (13 engineers). Reports that took two hours now take less than an hour.
- [1health: The platform behind new clinical products](https://neil.percipience.live/case-studies/healthcare-developer-platform/): Director of Platform Product and Partnerships, Jan 2026 – present. Built the developer-facing products of a HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2 Type II healthcare platform: the developer portal, Patient Vault (a headless API over 2.7M patient records) and MCP tooling that lets AI coding agents discover and call the APIs. Muse Bio went from Google Forms, spreadsheets and paper to a live donor program in about a month (https://dev.1health.io/case-studies/muse-bio). Expert-Dx went live in about a month (https://dev.1health.io/case-studies/expert-dx).
- [SpineZone: Online back and neck program](https://neil.percipience.live/case-studies/physical-therapy/): Co-Founder, VP of Product Management, Jan 2015 – Aug 2018. The online business broke even in eight months.
- [Sutter Health: HealthBridge and sleep monitoring](https://neil.percipience.live/case-studies/preventative-care/): Director of Business Design, Product Management, Jul 2019 – Aug 2021. Launched HealthBridge, which reached 90% engagement across hundreds of users.

## Earlier work

## Independent projects, built with AI coding agents

- [GiggleGauge](https://gigglegauge.com): Laughter tracker. Finds laughter in audio from a wearable and shows a daily count. Works with Omi devices. Has an MCP endpoint.
- [VocalMirror](https://vocalmirror.io): Voice reflection app.
- [Percipience](https://percipience.live): A personal view of fortnightly work cycles, heart-rate variability and laugh counts against the Sun, Moon and inner planets.
